record.original_question: What is a complete characterization of K4-free bricks, meaning bricks for which the complete graph K4 is not a conformal minor? Equivalently, which bricks fail to be K4-based under the paper's definition that a matching covered graph is J-based exactly when J is a conformal minor of it, and J-free otherwise?

evidence.quote: Given a fixed matching covered graph J, we say that a matching covered graph G is J-based if J is a conformal minor of G, and, otherwise G is J-free.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions.

A graph G is matching covered if it is connected, has at least one edge, and every edge of G lies in some perfect matching of G. A brick is a 3-connected matching covered graph G such that, for every pair of distinct vertices u, v, the graph G − {u, v} has a perfect matching (equivalently, a non-bipartite matching covered graph with no nontrivial tight cut).

Given a matching covered graph H, a bi-subdivision of H is a graph obtained from H by replacing each edge by a path of odd length (with new internal vertices of degree 2). A subgraph H' of a matching covered graph G is conformal if G − V(H') has a perfect matching. For matching covered graphs J and G, we say that J is a conformal minor of G if G contains a conformal subgraph that is a bi-subdivision of J. We call G "J-based" if J is a conformal minor of G, and "J-free" otherwise.

Let K4 denote the complete graph on four vertices.

Problem. Provide a complete structural characterization of all K4-free bricks, i.e., describe explicitly the class of bricks G such that K4 is not a conformal minor of G.
artifact.category_tag: matching covered graphs and conformal minors
artifact.status_search_result: The planar case has been resolved: Kothari and Murty characterized planar K4-free matching covered graphs, and a planar brick is K4-free iff it has exactly two odd faces. Subsequent work (e.g., on K4-free planar minimal bricks, essentially 4-edge-connected cubic bricks, and θ-free matching covered graphs) has produced further partial results, but the general (nonplanar) characterization of K4-free bricks remains open as of 2025.

status_evidence.title: K4-free and C6¯-free Planar Matching Covered Graphs (Kothari–Murty)
status_evidence.snippet: Characterization of planar K4-free matching covered graphs.
status_evidence.claim: The planar subcase of the characterization is solved.

status_evidence.title: K4-free planar minimal bricks with the maximum number of edges
status_evidence.snippet: Studies extremal properties of K4-free planar minimal bricks.
status_evidence.claim: Further partial/extremal results in the planar setting have appeared as recently as 2025.

status_evidence.title: On Two Unsolved Problems Concerning Matching Covered Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses unsolved problems on conformal minors in matching covered graphs.
status_evidence.claim: The general K4-free brick characterization is treated as an unsolved problem.

status_evidence.title: θ-free matching covered graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2024) study of related conformal-minor-free matching covered graph classes.
status_evidence.claim: Activity continues on related J-free brick characterizations, indicating the K4 case remains unresolved in general.
